problem_statement:
Jetpack Onboarding: Introduce a Stats step
This is a completely new step that will allow the user to enable the Stats module after connecting.

Initially, the step shows an introduction screen:

![](https://cldup.com/T9ECZ-HxdS.png)

Clicking the CTA button leads to the JPC flow if the user hasn't connected yet (we might need alternative copy for the headings):

![](https://cldup.com/lfJaNoj9ci.png)

![](https://cldup.com/vOjXnIxw8r.png)

Note that we'll need to preserve the JPO wizard navigation back / skip links at the bottom while in the JPC flow.

After connecting (or clicking the button after being connected already), stats module is being enabled for the user and they're presented with the following success screen:

![](https://cldup.com/7TLyDhlufk.png)

Where the success screen CTA leads to the next step.

For more information see p6TEKc-1Rd-p2
